_readme: When a presentation deck is ready:
1. Upload the file (PPT or PDF) to Box
4. Set its 'url' field to the Box shared link
5. Save this file, commit and push to GitHub
6. The dashboard updates live within ~30 seconds — no other changes needed
To clear a link (e.g. wrong file uploaded): set 'url' back to empty string ''
